intent: Build a class RateLimiter(max_calls, window_seconds). It has one method, allow(timestamp) (timestamp is a number of seconds). Each call to allow must FIRST discard any previously recorded call whose timestamp is <= timestamp - window_seconds (calls older than the trailing window are forgotten). If, after discarding, fewer than max_calls recorded timestamps remain, record this timestamp as a new call and return True; otherwise return False and do NOT record this timestamp.
oracle_test:
from ratelimiter import RateLimiter


def test_oracle():
    r = RateLimiter(2, 10)
    assert r.allow(0) is True
    assert r.allow(1) is True
    assert r.allow(2) is False
    assert r.allow(11) is True
    assert r.allow(12) is True
    assert r.allow(13) is False
